subject.title: Control UI: Worktrees mutation errors disappear during refresh

question: Which linked fix PR should be the canonical landing path for this protected issue?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same behavior, while one includes stronger real Gateway and browser-flow proof; selecting and landing one requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Land PR 106196
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196 because it includes authenticated Gateway reproduction, component coverage, and rendered Playwright flow proof.

options.title: Land PR 106190
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106190 if the smaller two-file implementation is preferred after equivalent real browser proof is supplied or independently verified.

recommendation.title: Land PR 106196
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196 because it includes authenticated Gateway reproduction, component coverage, and rendered Playwright flow proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the reproduction and the strongest currently documented landing candidate.
